user.title: Add a kiosk tablet
user.description: Kiosks on your network are usually found automatically. To add one by hand, enter the address its settings screen shows under Home Assistant.

pair.title: Pair with {name}
pair.description:
Pairing goes through the kiosk's dashboard login, so only someone who can log in to this Home Assistant can pair it.

Select **Submit**. If the kiosk ({host}) is already logged in to this Home Assistant, pairing finishes by itself. If not, it shows the login page: log in there within five minutes.

progress.wait_for_login: Waiting for {name} to confirm through its dashboard login. If the kiosk shows the Home Assistant login page, log in there.

error.cannot_connect: Cannot reach the kiosk app at this address.
error.busy: The kiosk is still finishing another pairing request. Try again in a few minutes.
error.timeout: The kiosk did not confirm within five minutes. Is its dashboard logged in to this Home Assistant?
error.wrong_device: A different kiosk answered than the one being added.

abort.already_configured: This kiosk is already set up.
abort.not_supported: This device does not identify itself as a kiosk.
